fee_notes: $27,000 for hotels with up to 100 guest rooms, plus $300 per additional room. Women-owned and veteran-owned businesses receive $10,000 reduction. In 2025, initial franchise fees ranged from $12,000 to $27,000. Dual Brand Hotels require $30,000 initial franchise fee per brand. Application fee of $3,000 is separate and additional.
raw_excerpt: You must pay a lump sum initial franchise fee when you sign the Franchise Agreement in the amount of $27,000 for hotels with up to 100 guest rooms. You must pay an additional $300 for each additional guest room.
